result.brief: 提出运动模式专家路由的因果高斯泼溅框架，用持久性、Transformer、图卷积与结构化约束专家混合预测动态3D高斯场景的未来运动。
result.reason: Forecasts future dynamic 3D Gaussian scenes with motion-regime experts, a causal future-scene prediction model; relates to world modeling of dynamics but is 3D/4D scene application rather than video/multimodal foundation model.
